s0001.literal: Broadly speaking, Confucians today rest on the ancient Six Learnings; these are the canonical books of royal instruction whereby the former sages clarified Heaven's Way, Editorial footnote marker 1. set human relations right, and established the settled methods of bringing order.
s0001.idiomatic: Broadly speaking, Confucians today rest on the ancient Six Learnings—the canonical books of royal instruction whereby the former sages clarified Heaven's Way, [1] set human relations right, and established settled methods of bringing order.

s0002.literal: Qin Shihuang burned the books and buried the scholars alive; from then on the Six Learnings were lost.
s0002.idiomatic: Qin Shihuang burned the books and buried the scholars alive; from then on the Six Learnings were lost.

s0003.literal: Emperor Wu of Han established erudites of the Five Classics,
s0003.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Han established erudites of the Five Classics,

s0005.literal: set up student quotas, Editorial footnote marker 2. established target-shooting examinations for office, and encouraged them with rank and salary; those who transmitted the learning were very numerous.
s0005.idiomatic: set up student quotas, [2] established target-shooting examinations for office, and encouraged them with rank and salary; those who transmitted the learning were very numerous.

s0006.literal: From the Two Han dynasties onward, those advanced as worthies all relied on classic learning.
s0006.idiomatic: From the Two Han dynasties onward, those advanced as worthies all relied on classic learning.

s0007.literal: Under Wei and Jin, frivolity prevailed and Confucian teaching declined; among grandees, gentry, and commoners, few mastered the classics.
s0007.idiomatic: Under Wei and Jin, frivolity prevailed and Confucian teaching declined; among grandees, gentry, and commoners, few mastered the classics.

s0008.literal: Between Song and Qi, the National University was from time to time reopened.
s0008.idiomatic: Between Song and Qi, the National University was from time to time reopened.

s0009.literal: Emperor Wu of Liang opened the Five Halls, established the National University, and altogether had the Five Classics taught,
s0009.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Liang opened the Five Halls, established the National University, and altogether had the Five Classics taught,

s0010.literal: Collation variant: (only the National University then the classics).
s0010.idiomatic: Collation variant: (only the National University then the classics).

s0011.literal: and for each classic appointed assistant instructors.
s0011.idiomatic: and for each classic appointed assistant instructors.

s0012.literal: Editorial footnote marker 3. The Emperor would sometimes unbend his imperial carriage and personally visit the schools, perform the libation sacrifice to the former teacher, himself test the students in caps, extend them banquets in discourse, and reward them with bundles of silk—abundant indeed; this was the splendor of an age.
s0012.idiomatic: [3] The emperor would sometimes unbend his imperial carriage and personally visit the schools, perform the libation sacrifice to the former teacher, himself test the students in caps, extend them banquets in discourse, and reward them with bundles of silk—abundant indeed; this was the splendor of an age.

s0013.literal: When the Founder laid the foundations of the state, he inherited the disorders of the previous age; caps and gowns were utterly destroyed and bandits were not yet pacified. With each day too full for his tasks, he had no leisure to encourage instruction.
s0013.idiomatic: When the Founder laid the foundations of the state, he inherited the disorders of the previous age; caps and gowns were utterly destroyed and bandits were not yet pacified. With each day too full for his tasks, he had no leisure to encourage instruction.

s0014.literal: From Emperor Wen downward, learning officials were gradually set up; though students were broadly recruited, those who completed their studies were few.
s0014.idiomatic: From Emperor Wen downward, learning officials were gradually set up; though students were broadly recruited, those who completed their studies were few.

s0015.literal: What is gathered here now are mostly the surviving Confucians of Liang.
s0015.idiomatic: What is gathered here now are mostly the surviving Confucians of Liang.

s0017.literal: Shen Wen'a, styled Guowei, was a native of Wukang in Wuxing.
s0017.idiomatic: Shen Wen'a, styled Guowei, came from Wukang in Wuxing.

s0018.literal: His father Jun was famed in Liang for Confucian learning and was appointed Inspector of Gui, but did not take up the post.
s0018.idiomatic: His father Jun was famed in Liang for Confucian learning and was appointed inspector of Gui, but did not take up the post.

s0019.literal: Wen'a was by nature stubborn and strong, with physical strength; in youth he studied his father's profession and probed deeply into chapter-and-verse learning.
s0019.idiomatic: Wen'a was by nature stubborn and strong, with physical strength; in youth he studied his father's profession and probed deeply into chapter-and-verse learning.

s0020.literal: His grandfather's brother-in-law the Grand Astrologer Shuming and his maternal uncle Wang Huixing both mastered classic learning, and Wen'a largely received their transmission.
s0020.idiomatic: His grandfather's brother-in-law the grand astrologer Shuming and his maternal uncle Wang Huixing both mastered classic learning, and Wen'a largely received their transmission.

s0021.literal: He also broadly collected the agreements and differences of earlier Confucians and composed expository commentaries of his own.
s0021.idiomatic: He also broadly collected the agreements and differences of earlier Confucians and composed expository commentaries of his own.

s0022.literal: He mastered the Three Rites and the Three Commentaries.
s0022.idiomatic: He mastered the Three Rites and the Three Commentaries.

s0023.literal: Recommended as Filial and Incorrupt, he became an aide in the establishment of Liang's Prince of Linchuan, and was repeatedly promoted to concurrent National University assistant instructor and erudite of the Five Classics.
s0023.idiomatic: Recommended as Filial and Incorrupt, he became an aide in the establishment of Liang's Prince of Linchuan, and was repeatedly promoted to concurrent national university assistant instructor and erudite of the Five Classics.

s0024.literal: When Liang's Emperor Jianwen was in the Eastern Palace, he was brought in as an academician and received deep courtesy; when the emperor compiled the Record of the Everlasting Spring, he often had Wen'a gather divergent accounts to enlarge it.
s0024.idiomatic: When Liang's Emperor Jianwen was in the eastern palace, he was brought in as an academician and received deep courtesy; when the emperor compiled the Record of the Everlasting Spring, he often had Wen'a gather divergent accounts to enlarge it.

s0025.literal: When Hou Jing rebelled, Jianwen separately sent Wen'a to recruit soldiers to relieve the capital.
s0025.idiomatic: When Hou Jing rebelled, Jianwen separately sent Wen'a to recruit soldiers to relieve the capital.

s0026.literal: When the city fell, he and Zhang Song together held Wuxing; when Song was defeated, Wen'a fled into the mountains and wilds.
s0026.idiomatic: When the city fell, he and Zhang Song together held Wuxing; when Song was defeated, Wen'a fled into the mountains and wilds.

s0027.literal: Jing had long heard his name and sought him urgently; Wen'a, hard pressed and not knowing where to turn, climbed a tree to hang himself, but a kinsman happened to save him; he then threw himself down and broke his left arm.
s0027.idiomatic: Jing had long heard his name and sought him urgently; Wen'a, hard pressed and not knowing where to turn, climbed a tree to hang himself, but a kinsman happened to save him; he then threw himself down and broke his left arm.

s0028.literal: When Jing was pacified, the Founder, because Wen'a was from his home district, memorialized to make him magistrate of Yuanxiang and overseer of Jiangyin commandery.
s0028.idiomatic: When Jing was pacified, the Founder, because Wen'a was from his home district, memorialized to make him magistrate of Yuanxiang and overseer of Jiangyin commandery.

s0029.literal: In the first year of Shaotai he entered service as erudite of the National University, and soon held concurrently the post of footsoldiers commandant and charge of ceremonial regulations.
s0029.idiomatic: In Shaotai year 1 (555) he entered service as erudite of the national university, and soon held concurrently the post of footsoldiers commandant and charge of ceremonial regulations.

s0030.literal: From the Taqing turmoil onward, the precedents of the palace offices had nothing left preserved; Wen'a's father Jun in Emperor Wu of Liang's time had once held charge of court ceremony and had left considerable drafts, and so Wen'a weighed and trimmed them to compose anew—ceremonial norms all issued from him.
s0030.idiomatic: From the Taqing turmoil onward, the precedents of the palace offices had nothing left preserved; Wen'a's father Jun in Emperor Wu of Liang's time had once held charge of court ceremony and had left considerable drafts, and so Wen'a weighed and trimmed them to compose anew—ceremonial norms all issued from him.

s0031.literal: When the Founder received the abdication, Wen'a at once left office and returned to Wukang; the Founder was greatly angered and sent envoys to execute him.
s0031.idiomatic: When the Founder received the abdication, Wen'a at once left office and returned to Wukang; the Founder was greatly angered and sent envoys to execute him.

s0032.literal: At that time Wen'a's clansman Shen Ke was administrator of the commandery; he asked the envoys to spare his life, then bound him with his face exposed and the collar locked and delivered him to the Founder. The Founder looked at him and laughed, saying, "What is a rotten Confucian good for?
s0032.idiomatic: At that time Wen'a's clansman Shen Ke was administrator of the commandery; he asked the envoys to spare his life, then bound him with his face exposed and the collar locked and delivered him to the Founder. The Founder looked at him and laughed, saying, "What is a rotten Confucian good for?

s0034.literal: When the Founder died, Wen'a together with Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Xu Ling, Secretariat attendant Liu Shizhi, and others debated the regulations for the garments of the attendants at the late emperor's spirit seat and imperial couch on the great journey; the discussion is in Shizhi's biography.
s0034.idiomatic: When the Founder died, Wen'a together with left vice director Xu Ling, Secretariat attendant Liu Shizhi, and others debated the regulations for the garments of the attendants at the late emperor's spirit seat and imperial couch on the great journey; the discussion is in Shizhi's biography.

s0035.literal: When Emperor Wen assumed the imperial throne, on the appointed day he visited the ancestral temple; Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yu Chi, Editorial footnote marker 4. received the edict and sent erudites to debate the ceremony.
s0035.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen assumed the imperial throne, on the appointed day he visited the ancestral temple; right vice director Yu Chi, [4] received the edict and sent erudites to debate the ceremony.

s0037.literal: Things among the people shift; substance and ornament differ in their tracks; sages establish teaching according to the occasion, and kings and dukes adapt to what is fitting for the time.
s0037.idiomatic: Things among the people shift; substance and ornament differ in their tracks; sages establish teaching according to the occasion, and kings and dukes adapt to what is fitting for the time.

s0038.literal: When a thousand men have no lord, if they do not disperse they fall into disorder; when the myriad chariots have no master, if there is no peril they perish.
s0038.idiomatic: When a thousand men have no lord, if they do not disperse they fall into disorder; when the myriad chariots have no master, if there is no peril they perish.

s0039.literal: In the flourishing age of high Zhou, the Duke of Zhou was uncle and minister, Lü and Shao were talons and teeth; King Cheng was in mourning and disaster nearly overturned the state.
s0039.idiomatic: In the flourishing age of high Zhou, the Duke of Zhou was uncle and minister, Lü and Shao were talons and teeth; King Cheng was in mourning and disaster nearly overturned the state.

s0040.literal: Therefore, once the burial was completed there was at once the ceremony of the ducal cap; at the first encoffining he received the policy of the hemp cap and mourning robe.
s0040.idiomatic: Therefore, once the burial was completed there was at once the ceremony of the ducal cap; at the first encoffining he received the policy of the hemp cap and mourning robe.

s0041.literal: This was to show the realm that there was a lord and to take thought for the hardship of the altars of soil and grain.
s0041.idiomatic: This was to show the realm that there was a lord and to take thought for the hardship of the altars of soil and grain.

s0042.literal: Down to the late age of contending states, Han inherited its abuses; though Wen and Jing suspended punishments, the Seven States still linked arms in war.
s0042.idiomatic: Down to the late age of contending states, Han inherited its abuses; though Wen and Jing suspended punishments, the Seven States still linked arms in war.

s0043.literal: Some took the throne after a month, some proclaimed edicts on the day of the death—these were all done with purpose and were not without concern for ritual institutions.
s0043.idiomatic: Some took the throne after a month, some proclaimed edicts on the day of the death—these were all done with purpose and were not without concern for ritual institutions.

s0044.literal: Now on the day of the state's mourning taboo, though grief is restrained by the weight of the seal and sash, the order between ruler and minister has not yet been set.
s0044.idiomatic: Now on the day of the state's mourning taboo, though grief is restrained by the weight of the seal and sash, the order between ruler and minister has not yet been set.

s0045.literal: In ancient rites, after retiring from the temple audience one sat in the main chamber and heard the ministers' government; now when the emperor returns from bowing at the temple, he should take his seat in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate to set right the dignity of facing south—this is like King Kang of Zhou in court with one or two ministers guarding him.
s0045.idiomatic: In ancient rites, after retiring from the temple audience one sat in the main chamber and heard the ministers' government; now when the emperor returns from bowing at the temple, he should take his seat in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate to set right the dignity of facing south—this is like King Kang of Zhou in court with one or two ministers guarding him.

s0046.literal: As for the rite of laying the offering in the burial mound, the Rites of Zhou take jade to make the tribute-gift: dukes and marquises use the gui, viscounts and barons hold the bi—this is auspicious jade.
s0046.idiomatic: As for the rite of laying the offering in the burial mound, the Rites of Zhou take jade to make the tribute-gift: dukes and marquises use the gui, viscounts and barons hold the bi—this is auspicious jade.

s0047.literal: Once the tribute-gift offering was finished, they again presented the offering of enjoyment; the Son of Heaven used the bi, the queen used the cong.
s0047.idiomatic: Once the tribute-gift offering was finished, they again presented the offering of enjoyment; the Son of Heaven used the bi, the queen used the cong.

s0048.literal: Qin burned the classics; regalia and ceremony scattered and perished; when Shusun Tong fixed the rites, he especially lost the former statutes—the tribute-gift offering had no gui, the enjoyment offering had no silk, dukes and kings alike used the bi, and the Court Chamberlain presented congratulations.
s0048.idiomatic: Qin burned the classics; regalia and ceremony scattered and perished; when Shusun Tong fixed the rites, he especially lost the former statutes—the tribute-gift offering had no gui, the enjoyment offering had no silk, dukes and kings alike used the bi, and the court chamberlain presented congratulations.

s0049.literal: Matters such as these are not heard of in antiquity; later ages handed them down in succession, down to Liang, which practiced them.
s0049.idiomatic: Matters such as these are not heard of in antiquity; later ages handed them down in succession, down to Liang, which practiced them.

s0050.literal: Raising the cup and offering longevity is the great celebration of state and family; in the four side halls elegant music is played and songs of joy are performed.
s0050.idiomatic: Raising the cup and offering longevity is the great celebration of state and family; in the four side halls elegant music is played and songs of joy are performed.

s0051.literal: Now ruler and ministers swallow grief and the myriad people restrain their sorrow—how can this be the same as the rites of renewal?
s0051.idiomatic: Now ruler and ministers swallow grief and the myriad people restrain their sorrow—how can this be the same as the rites of renewal?

s0052.literal: Moreover, in King Kang's guest-rite they offered the gui in homage but there was no presentation of ten thousand years of life—here the earlier standard is clear.
s0052.idiomatic: Moreover, in King Kang's guest-rite they offered the gui in homage but there was no presentation of ten thousand years of life—here the earlier standard is clear.

s0053.literal: Three nights of lodging and three calls of warning—the upper sacrifice is called the offering; this is surely the ritual of the feast-guest receiving blessing—how can it be called congratulatory wine!
s0053.idiomatic: Three nights of lodging and three calls of warning—the upper sacrifice is called the offering; this is surely the ritual of the feast-guest receiving blessing—how can it be called congratulatory wine!

s0054.literal: I humbly hold that on this occasion, sitting in the main hall, one should perform only the rite of presenting the bi on the mat and have no congratulatory wine.
s0054.idiomatic: I humbly hold that on this occasion, sitting in the main hall, one should perform only the rite of presenting the bi on the mat and have no congratulatory wine.

s0055.literal: I respectfully draft the protocol for returning from the temple audience, ascending the main chamber, and the ministers attending with the offering, as set forth separately.
s0055.idiomatic: I respectfully draft the protocol for returning from the temple audience, ascending the main chamber, and the ministers attending with the offering, as set forth separately.

s0056.literal: An edict approved and ordered it implemented.
s0056.idiomatic: An edict approved and ordered it implemented.

s0057.literal: Soon he was moved to regular attendant of the direct and unbent scattered cavalry, concurrent erudite of the National University, and charge of the Feathered Forest guard; he was still ordered to lecture on the Classic of Filial Piety and the Analects in the Eastern Palace.
s0057.idiomatic: Soon he was moved to regular attendant of the direct and unbent scattered cavalry, concurrent erudite of the national university, and charge of the feathered forest guard; he was still ordered to lecture on the Classic of Filial Piety and the Analects in the eastern palace.

s0058.literal: In the fourth year of Tiancheng he died, aged sixty-one.
s0058.idiomatic: In Tiancheng year 4 (563) he died, aged sixty-one.

s0059.literal: An edict posthumously enfeoffed him as Minister of Justice.
s0059.idiomatic: An edict posthumously enfeoffed him as minister of justice.

s0060.literal: Wen'a's compositions on ceremonial regulations, more than eighty juan, and Great Meanings of the Classics, eighteen juan, all circulated in the world; many Confucians transmitted his learning.
s0060.idiomatic: Wen'a's compositions on ceremonial regulations, more than eighty juan, and Great Meanings of the Classics, eighteen juan, all circulated in the world; many Confucians transmitted his learning.

s0061.literal: Shen Zhu, styled Hongdao, was a native of Wukang in Wuxing.
s0061.idiomatic: Shen Zhu, styled Hongdao, came from Wukang in Wuxing.

s0062.literal: His grandfather Xiuzhi, Editorial footnote marker 5. was Liang magistrate of Yuhang.
s0062.idiomatic: His grandfather Xiuzhi, [5] was Liang magistrate of Yuhang.

s0063.literal: His father Shanqing was a Liang erudite of the National University and gentleman of the scattered cavalry.
s0063.idiomatic: His father Shanqing was a Liang erudite of the national university and gentleman of the scattered cavalry.

s0064.literal: Zhu from youth was proper and elegant, fond of learning, and did not make friends lightly.
s0064.idiomatic: Zhu from youth was proper and elegant, fond of learning, and did not make friends lightly.

s0065.literal: He mastered the Three Rites and the Zuo Tradition to the Spring and Autumn.
s0065.idiomatic: He mastered the Three Rites and the Zuo Tradition to the Spring and Autumn.

s0066.literal: With keen understanding and strong memory, on the chapter-and-verse of the Five Classics and the books of the masters and histories, there was nothing he could not answer when asked.
s0066.idiomatic: With keen understanding and strong memory, on the chapter-and-verse of the Five Classics and the books of the masters and histories, there was nothing he could not answer when asked.

s0067.literal: He doffed the headcloth as left regular attendant of Liang's Prince of Xiangdong's establishment, was moved to inner aide in the central army of the Prince of Xuancheng, was appointed recorder in the establishment of the Prince of Linhe of Renwei, and was promoted to director of the Masters of Writing's Bureau of Sacrifices—he was then a little over twenty.
s0067.idiomatic: He doffed the headcloth as left regular attendant of Liang's Prince of Xiangdong's establishment, was moved to inner aide in the central army of the Prince of Xuancheng, was appointed recorder in the establishment of the Prince of Linhe of Renwei, and was promoted to director of the Masters of Writing's Bureau of Sacrifices—he was then a little over twenty.

s0068.literal: In the Datong period, many students ranged widely through literature and history and did not work on chapter-and-verse, but Zhu alone piled thought on classic learning; Zhu Yi of Wu commandery and He Chen of Kuaiji greatly praised him.
s0068.idiomatic: In the Datong period, many students ranged widely through literature and history and did not work on chapter-and-verse, but Zhu alone piled thought on classic learning; Zhu Yi of Wu commandery and He Chen of Kuaiji greatly praised him.

s0069.literal: When Yi and Chen lectured on the imperially directed meanings at the Forest of Scholars Hall, Zhu was regularly made chief expounder.
s0069.idiomatic: When Yi and Chen lectured on the imperially directed meanings at the Forest of Scholars Hall, Zhu was regularly made chief expounder.

s0070.literal: In Hou Jing's rebellion Zhu fled to Lin'an; at that time Emperor Wen was there and personally came to study under him.
s0070.idiomatic: In Hou Jing's rebellion Zhu fled to Lin'an; at that time Emperor Wen was there and personally came to study under him.

s0071.literal: When the Founder entered as regent, Zhu was made erudite of the National University and together with Shen Wen'a held charge of ceremonial regulations.
s0071.idiomatic: When the Founder entered as regent, Zhu was made erudite of the national university and together with Shen Wen'a held charge of ceremonial regulations.

s0072.literal: When the Founder received the abdication, Zhu was additionally made supernumerary regular attendant of the scattered cavalry and served in succession as aide in the Yangzhou separate office, grand director of works,
s0072.idiomatic: When the Founder received the abdication, Zhu was additionally made supernumerary regular attendant of the scattered cavalry and served in succession as aide in the Yangzhou separate office, grand director of works,

s0073.literal: The relevant office memorialized that the former General Who Pacifies the Distance and magistrate of Jiankang Shen Xiaogui's student Chen San'er submitted a petition stating that his master's father's coffin was in Zhou, that the master was on mission within the passes and wished to bring back the coffin, but had long failed to return.
s0073.idiomatic: The relevant office memorialized that the former general who pacifies the distance and magistrate of Jiankang Shen Xiaogui's student Chen San'er submitted a petition stating that his master's father's coffin was in Zhou, that the master was on mission within the passes and wished to bring back the coffin, but had long failed to return.

s0074.literal: The end of this month is the second anniversary; the master's younger brother and son who are here—should they remove the spirit by month's end and the inner and outer circles observe auspicious dress?
s0074.idiomatic: The end of this month is the second anniversary; the master's younger brother and son who are here—should they remove the spirit by month's end and the inner and outer circles observe auspicious dress?

s0075.literal: Or should they wait until the master returns and the propriety of feeling is fully carried through?
s0075.idiomatic: Or should they wait until the master returns and the propriety of feeling is fully carried through?

s0076.literal: The matter was referred to Left Vice Director Jiang Dezao; Dezao argued: "Wang Weijun said: 'When mourning is long unburied, only the master does not change; the rest of the kin each complete the month-count and remove mourning.'
s0076.idiomatic: The matter was referred to left vice director Jiang Dezao; Dezao argued: "Wang Weijun said: 'When mourning is long unburied, only the master does not change; the rest of the kin each complete the month-count and remove mourning.'

s0077.literal: This is citing ritual text to discuss those at home who have an affair and have not yet been able to bury.
s0077.idiomatic: This is citing ritual text to discuss those at home who have an affair and have not yet been able to bury.

s0078.literal: Xiaogui is in a foreign land; though he has already sent to bring back the coffin, the date of return is uncertain; if the younger brothers proceed at once to remove mourning, they would forever cut off marriage—this in human feeling may perhaps not be acceptable.
s0078.idiomatic: Xiaogui is in a foreign land; though he has already sent to bring back the coffin, the date of return is uncertain; if the younger brothers proceed at once to remove mourning, they would forever cut off marriage—this in human feeling may perhaps not be acceptable.

s0079.literal: After the Central Plains fell, there have been cases in principle; the regular attendant Shen should be consulted for detailed deliberation."
s0079.idiomatic: After the Central Plains fell, there have been cases in principle; the regular attendant Shen should be consulted for detailed deliberation."

s0081.literal: Rites have the orthodox and also adaptation to what is fitting. The Record of Smaller Matters in Rites says: 'When mourning is long unburied, only the chief
s0081.idiomatic: Rites have the orthodox and also adaptation to what is fitting. The Record of Smaller Matters in Rites says: 'When mourning is long unburied, only the chief

s0083.literal: mourner does not remove mourning; Editorial footnote marker 6. the rest, when the hemp month-count is completed, remove mourning and that is all.'
s0083.idiomatic: mourner does not remove mourning; [6] the rest, when the hemp month-count is completed, remove mourning and that is all.'

s0084.literal: The commentary says: 'The rest means collateral kin.'
s0084.idiomatic: The commentary says: 'The rest means collateral kin.'

s0085.literal: As Zheng interprets it, all the sons should not remove mourning; what Wang Weijun cited is the orthodox of the rites.
s0085.idiomatic: As Zheng interprets it, all the sons should not remove mourning; what Wang Weijun cited is the orthodox of the rites.

s0086.literal: Editorial footnote marker 7. But in Wei, at the eastern-pass campaign, when the corpse and coffin were lost and burial had no set date, deliberation held that the rites have no mourning for a lifetime, and so regulations were made to remove the garments.
s0086.idiomatic: [7] But in Wei, at the eastern-pass campaign, when the corpse and coffin were lost and burial had no set date, deliberation held that the rites have no mourning for a lifetime, and so regulations were made to remove the garments.

s0087.literal: In Jin, amid mourning turmoil, some died in the barbarian court with no means to bring the coffin home; south of the Yangtze they therefore again clarified the regulation.
s0087.idiomatic: In Jin, amid mourning turmoil, some died in the barbarian court with no means to bring the coffin home; south of the Yangtze they therefore again clarified the regulation.

s0088.literal: Li Yin's grandfather and Wang Hua's father were both alive or dead unknown; their sons put on mourning garments and released the hemp at the proper time—these are all cases of adapting the rites to what is fitting.
s0088.idiomatic: Li Yin's grandfather and Wang Hua's father were both alive or dead unknown; their sons put on mourning garments and released the hemp at the proper time—these are all cases of adapting the rites to what is fitting.

s0089.literal: Though Xiaogui, because he was on mission, wished to bring back the coffin, the barbarians are hard to approach and the date of return is not yet fixed.
s0089.idiomatic: Though Xiaogui, because he was on mission, wished to bring back the coffin, the barbarians are hard to approach and the date of return is not yet fixed.

s0090.literal: I humbly hold that one should follow the eastern-pass precedent: those within this state should all release the hemp garments, destroy the spirit seat, and attach the sacrifice; if the coffin can be brought back, a separate ceremony of reburial should be performed.
s0090.idiomatic: I humbly hold that one should follow the eastern-pass precedent: those within this state should all release the hemp garments, destroy the spirit seat, and attach the sacrifice; if the coffin can be brought back, a separate ceremony of reburial should be performed.

s0091.literal: Since the realm fell into bandit turmoil and the western court was overturned, people were cast to remote regions and feeling and propriety could not be expressed—such persons surely are not one or two; how can mourning periods be without number while they do not remove the mourning garments? The court itself should set limits, cutting affection by right, and broadly consult the learned to settle it at the center of the rites.
s0091.idiomatic: Since the realm fell into bandit turmoil and the western court was overturned, people were cast to remote regions and feeling and propriety could not be expressed—such persons surely are not one or two; how can mourning periods be without number while they do not remove the mourning garments? The court itself should set limits, cutting affection by right, and broadly consult the learned to settle it at the center of the rites.

s0092.literal: Dezao followed Zhu's argument; the memorial was approved.
s0092.idiomatic: Dezao followed Zhu's argument; the memorial was approved.

s0093.literal: When Emperor Wen assumed the throne, Zhu was moved to regular attendant of the direct and unbent scattered cavalry and lectured in attendance in the Eastern Palace.
s0093.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen assumed the throne, Zhu was moved to regular attendant of the direct and unbent scattered cavalry and lectured in attendance in the eastern palace.

s0094.literal: Soon he held concurrently the post of Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and charge of the Yangzhou chief rectifier, was moved to Minister of the Household, and his lecturing attendance remained as before.
s0094.idiomatic: Soon he held concurrently the post of left vice director of the Masters of Writing and charge of the Yangzhou chief rectifier, was moved to minister of the household, and his lecturing attendance remained as before.

s0095.literal: When the Deposed Emperor succeeded, Zhu again became regular attendant of the direct and unbent scattered cavalry and concurrent Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
s0095.idiomatic: When the Deposed Emperor succeeded, Zhu again became regular attendant of the direct and unbent scattered cavalry and concurrent left vice director of the Masters of Writing.

s0096.literal: He was moved to General Who Displays Martial Might and chief clerk to the Prince of Hengyang of the Light Chariots, acting in the prince's establishment affairs, with concurrent charge as commandery aide of Langye and Pengcheng.
s0096.idiomatic: He was moved to general who displays martial might and chief clerk to the Prince of Hengyang of the Light Chariots, acting in the prince's establishment affairs, with concurrent charge as commandery aide of Langye and Pengcheng.

s0097.literal: Under Liang's old statutes, the method of pressing prisoners for confession was once a day, beginning at the twilight drum and ending at the second watch.
s0097.idiomatic: Under Liang's old statutes, the method of pressing prisoners for confession was once a day, beginning at the twilight drum and ending at the second watch.

s0098.literal: When Director of the Bureau of Review Fan Quan revised the statutes and ordinances, because the old method of pressing by time was long and not what a man could bear, he divided the time-markers and made it twice a day.
s0098.idiomatic: When director of the Bureau of Review Fan Quan revised the statutes and ordinances, because the old method of pressing by time was long and not what a man could bear, he divided the time-markers and made it twice a day.

s0099.literal: The Court Tribunal held that the new regulation was too light and requested that the eight chief ministers, directors and vice directors, together with libationer Kong Huan and acting officer Shen Zhu and the five attendants meet in the Masters of Writing office for detailed deliberation.
s0099.idiomatic: The court tribunal held that the new regulation was too light and requested that the eight chief ministers, directors and vice directors, together with libationer Kong Huan and acting officer Shen Zhu and the five attendants meet in the Masters of Writing office for detailed deliberation.

s0100.literal: At that time Emperor Xuan was Recorder of the Masters of Writing; he gathered the assembly to debate it. Director of Punishments Zhou Hongzheng said: "It is not known how many persons in the prison are pressed for confession—how many confess?
